answer: Mesa-plot census bond: each agent locks 70 and files one return for a mesa plot. Each epoch, auditors re-count sampled plots; any delta between return and recount burns the bond. A rented return carries one key's echo across plots, so duplicates burn together. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 45 = 45,000, plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool: a net loss of 75,000. An honest agent files once for 45 and keeps its full share.
